arts.ttl: Pre-Match Analysis: Crystal Palace face Strasbourg in crucial European test
arts.sum: They have the ability to cause Palace problems and it will be their toughest test in Europe so far but if Lacroix maintains his current form, Palace’s back line will feel far more secure. Crystal Palace currently sit ninth in the Europa Conference League table and are only out of the top eight automatic qualifying spots on goal difference.
